nodes.label: Recruitment Orchestrator
nodes.description: Manager agent that routes recruitment intake, screening, ranking, approval, and scheduling tasks.

agents.name: Recruitment Orchestrator
agents.description: Routes intake, screening, ranking, approval, and scheduling tasks; enforces human approval and returns a unified result to the app.
agents.tools_data_sources: Outputs from all sub-agents; role configuration; recruiter approval state
agents.trigger: New intake, screening request, rerank request, or approved interview slot

managed_agents.name: Gmail Resume Intake
managed_agents.usage_description: Use for manual or configured intake runs that search the authorized Gmail scope and normalize likely application messages and resume attachments for recruiter review.

managed_agents.name: Outlook Resume Intake
managed_agents.usage_description: Use for manual or configured intake runs that search the authorized Microsoft Outlook scope and normalize likely application messages and resume attachments for recruiter review.

managed_agents.name: Evidence-Based Screener
managed_agents.usage_description: Use when a recruiter requests criteria extraction, approved-criteria screening, explainable scorecards, ranking, or reranking for candidates within one role.

managed_agents.name: Google Interview Coordinator
managed_agents.usage_description: Use for Google Calendar availability options or approved Google scheduling actions, with Gmail communication only after explicit recruiter approval of the exact slot and draft.

managed_agents.name: Microsoft Interview Coordinator
managed_agents.usage_description: Use for Microsoft Calendar availability options or approved Microsoft scheduling actions, with Outlook communication only after explicit recruiter approval of the exact slot and draft.

agents.name: Gmail Resume Intake
agents.description: Searches authorized Gmail scope for likely applications, retrieves relevant attachments, and returns normalized candidate-source records for recruiter review.
agents.trigger: Manual inbox sync or configured intake run

agents.name: Outlook Resume Intake
agents.description: Searches authorized Outlook scope for likely applications, retrieves relevant attachments, and returns normalized candidate-source records for recruiter review.
agents.trigger: Manual inbox sync or configured intake run

agents.name: Evidence-Based Screener
agents.description: Converts job descriptions into reviewable criteria, evaluates resumes only against approved criteria, cites evidence, records uncertainty, and produces comparable scorecards.
agents.tools_data_sources: Parsed job descriptions and resumes supplied by the app
agents.trigger: Recruiter starts screening or changes approved criteria

agents.name: Google Interview Coordinator
agents.description: Checks authorized Google Calendar availability, proposes time-zone-safe slots, and creates the event only after approval; uses Gmail for the approved communication.
agents.trigger: Recruiter requests options or approves a Google-based slot

agents.name: Microsoft Interview Coordinator
agents.description: Checks authorized Microsoft Calendar availability, proposes time-zone-safe slots, and creates the event only after approval; uses Outlook for the approved communication.
agents.trigger: Recruiter requests options or approves a Microsoft-based slot
